title: Slightly Nicer Spears
description: Doesn't spear textures look strange to you? I made them worse, so it would look more consistent
body:
So... what's exactly changing..?
1. Tips. Now they make less sense, just as any other tool. Tried to mix on spear some axe and shovel shading logic
2. Handles. No handles. There never were any handles, so why start now?
3. No material pixel on the end for the same reason.

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5ac3d3cfd5ddf25352427cd1ce2e4edb400119c.png)

but... why?
Cuz spear textures were very annoying to me. They looked SO OFF compared to other tools!!!
